# Water's Ebitengine changes

Base: github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2 v2.10.0, copied from the Go module distribution. Upstream LICENSE and NOTICE.md are retained. The upstream example applications and .github directory are omitted; examples/resources is retained for library tests. Library sources and tests are unchanged except for the files listed below. Trailing whitespace in the two bundled font-license files is normalized; their legal text is unchanged. The root go.mod replacement makes these fixes reproducible without changing the module cache.

- `internal/ui/ui_glfw.go`: sample native visibility/occlusion after processing events, so a restoration handled by WaitEvents does not use the window's pre-event presentation state.
- `internal/ui/ui_glfw.go`, `internal/ui/export_glfw_test.go`, `internal/ui/ui_glfw_test.go`: re-enumerate the monitors when the window's actual content scale disagrees with the cached monitor's device scale factor. A monitor snapshot keeps the scale and bounds read when the monitor was first seen, and a display mode change (resolution or HiDPI/low-resolution switch) is not reported as a monitor connect or disconnect event, so a long-running process would otherwise keep rendering at the previous resolution until it restarted.
- `internal/ui/context.go`, `internal/ui/ui_vmguest_desktop.go`: propagate the native backend's presentation decision into final-screen drawing. Offscreen drawing and screenshot readback still run for a hidden/occluded window; real-screen commands are not queued for a frame that will not present. This avoids accumulating commands that a later readback would flush outside a normal present.
- `internal/graphicsdriver/metal/ca/ca_darwin.go`, `internal/graphicsdriver/metal/graphics_darwin.go`: explicitly retain a cached Metal drawable across `End(false)` autorelease-pool boundaries. Transfer that owned reference through normal or transaction-synced presentation, then release it. An end-frame present also submits an otherwise empty command buffer if it must finish a drawable left by readback.

Native regression: `go run ./tests/fixtures/metal-readback` from the Water root (run beneath the shared GUI test lock). It deliberately queues a real-screen draw, modifies/reads an offscreen to force `End(false)`, then reuses the drawable. The original dependency reproduces a `MetalDrawable.Texture` SIGSEGV; the patched dependency completes 24 readback flushes in one frame with pixel assertions. The --empty-present variant finishes after the last readback without another draw, covering the empty-command-buffer present path. These regressions are included in macOS GUI profiles by scripts/go-ui-metal-readback-smoke.py. This exercises object lifetime on native macOS and cannot be replaced by Go race or a cross-build.
